share-kit.chunk.this-card-could-not-be-r.text: This card could not be read.
share-kit.chunk.this-card-could-not-be-r.note: Import error when a shared card file cannot be read. It tells the user the card was not imported.

share-kit.notice.author-name-is-optional.text: Author name is optional. A name is personal data. If you fill it in, it is written into the file and everyone who gets the file can read it. Use a nickname if you prefer, and do not add an email address or contact details. Leave it empty to share without a name.
share-kit.notice.author-name-is-optional.note: Privacy note on the export panel when the items carry an author name. It says the name is personal data and is written into the file.

share-kit.notice.only-import-files-from-.text: Only import files from people you trust. Magic Card checks the file and shows a preview, and nothing is saved until you confirm. Look at the preview, the actions and the templates before you confirm.
share-kit.notice.only-import-files-from-.note: Warning above the preview of every import, before the Confirm button. It tells the user to trust the sender and to look at the preview, actions and templates first.
